summary: Frontend-only mobile regression and new Part Design flow testing completed on public preview URL. New Pocket/Chamfer/Fillet/Mirror actions are present, core Part Design-to-3D workflows are functional, and prior sheet/manual/unit flows mostly hold. One recurring mobile usability defect remains in the feature property sheet close interaction.

ui_bugs.issue: On 375x667 viewport, close button intermittently becomes outside tappable viewport during repeated feature-add/edit sequences (observed in automated runs; required JS fallback to continue).

action_items: Fix FeaturePropertySheet close-button layout/tap reliability for 375x667 so it remains consistently tappable without automation workaround.
Re-test full Part Design chain after close-button fix: Pad -> Pocket -> Chamfer -> Mirror -> 3D.
Optional code quality follow-up: split oversized frontend files (canvas.tsx, viewer3d.tsx) into smaller modules for maintainability and safer regression testing.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/canvas.tsx exceeds 700 lines (currently ~1500+); violates size guideline and increases regression risk.
frontend/app/viewer3d.tsx exceeds 700 lines (currently ~1000+); should be split into rendering/hooks/control modules.
Env var naming in code uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while architecture notes EXPO_BACKEND_URL; keep one canonical key to avoid deployment drift.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated via public preview URL in mobile viewport (375x667). Confirmed: feature tree exposes Pocket/Chamfer/Fillet/Mirror; pocket creates profileExtrude with holes=1; chamfer creates profileExtrude with outlinePoints=8; mirror flow produces two solids in elementsData (types: pad, mirror; xs: [0,360]). Manual line constraints and convert-lines-to-panels still function. Intermittent property-sheet close accessibility issue remains.
rca_of_issue: RCA (close control): FeaturePropertySheet is a bottom modal with dynamic content and max height. During repeated add/select feature transitions, close target can render in a position where Playwright reports it outside viewport despite selector visibility. Repro: Add multiple features and open/close property sheets in sequence on 375x667; normal click intermittently fails with outside-viewport error. Mitigation: tighten modal header anchoring and safe-area constraints so close control remains within visible/tappable bounds at all times.
